{{Top|leg}}
'''Lettuce''' was a type of [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] that was used in various [[Foodstuff/Legends|dishes]].<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], used a variety of lettuce in its dishes including [[mega-leaf lettuce]], [[pink lettuce]], [[Revwien lettuce]] and [[Sizhranian lettuce/Legends|Sizhranian lettuce]].<ref name="Menu" />
